task5_level_discrepancies.word: ceiling, floor, wall, door, window, roof
task5_level_discrepancies.issue: Ceiling is in `a1/home/rooms.json`, while roof, wall, door, window, floor appear in `a0_a1/` or `a1/` across different files.
task5_level_discrepancies.recommendation: Place basic structural room/building parts in `vocabulary/en/a0_a1/home/rooms.json` or `vocabulary/en/a0_a1/home/homes.json` consistently at A1 level.

task5_level_discrepancies.issue: `lease:verb` and `rent:noun` are in `a2/home/rooms.json`, while `lease:noun` is in `b1/home/furniture/general.json` with `levels: ["A2", "B1"]`.
task5_level_discrepancies.recommendation: Harmonize level tagging to A2/B1 across noun/verb forms in `home/homes.json`.

task5_level_discrepancies.issue: 86 terms in B1 and 7 terms in B2 in `home/furniture/general.json` are mostly travel/transit/urban planning terms erroneously assigned to Home B1/B2.
task5_level_discrepancies.recommendation: Re-level or re-home non-furniture items to their respective non-home domains, leaving true Home B1/B2 vocabulary (e.g. `insulation`, `electrical wiring`, `ventilation`, `tenancy agreement`).
